About

Garland TX Police Incidents

This site plots the weekly police incident report for Garland, TX onto a map. Each incident is shown as a bounding box around its reported block. Hover for the category, click for the full record.

Source data comes from the City of Garland's Crime Statistics & Maps page. Some incidents have confidential addresses — those are listed in the side panel on the map instead.

The pipeline (PDF download → extraction → geocoding → map) is open source on GitHub.

Roadmap

  • Persist incidents across weeks for historical comparison
  • Filter by district and category
  • Highlight aggravated and violent incidents
  • Automate the full refresh on a weekly schedule
